newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 14 muni bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 14 muni bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Thursday it qualified for bond insurance the following 14 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale:
--Nettleton Special School District, Ark., $2.125 million refunding bonds.
--Wynne School District No 9, Ark., $4.2 million construction bonds.
--Lakewood Public Schools, Mich., $19.95 million school building bonds.
--Passaic County, N.J., $5.404 million and $6.404 million County College bonds.
--Longview, Texas, $11.815 million water and sewer improvement revenue bonds.
--North Texas Municipal Water, Texas, $3 million waste water loan revenue refunding bonds.
MBIA said it also qualified Portchester Village, N.Y.'s $1.915 million GOs, which will sell Oct 29.
